text:
maya: Quick sync — we need one more pass on the Hosted / Dedicated / Private landing copy. Launch next week, want final hero lines + 2 CTAs per page. Who can take lead on Hosted?
jonas: I can own Hosted. Thinking hero should lean into predictable performance + easy dev experience.
sara: For layout, hero needs short subhead (1 line) and 3 micro-benefits under it. Keep visuals simple for enterprise.
kevin: Product note — Dedicated should call out SLA, reserved capacity, and burst options. Private must highlight VPC, KMS, and on-prem air-gapped option.
maya: Cool. Drafted a few micro-variants below — pick favorites and I'll iterate.
maya: HOSTED HERO VARIANTS:
maya: 1) "Fast, reliable LLM inference that just works" — sub: "Start with our hosted API and scale without ops."
maya: 2) "Turn models into production features — instantly" — sub: "Low-latency API, streaming, and cost controls."
maya: 3) "Production LLMs, no infrastructure headache" — sub: "Hosted inference with transparent performance and usage insights."
jonas: I like 2 for dev focus. 1 is a bit generic. 3 is good for cost/observability audience.
kevin: For CTAs: primary "Get started — free credits" secondary "See performance benchmarks"
sara: Design note: CTA color should be primary for Get started, outline for benchmarks. We'll show token-cost chart on page fold.
maya: DEDICATED HERO VARIANTS:
maya: A) "Predictable throughput for business-critical LLMs" — sub: "Reserved GPU pools, SLA-backed latency, and isolation."
maya: B) "Capacity you control, performance you can trust" — sub: "Configure autoscaling, burst capacity, and private routing policies."
jonas: A feels stronger for enterprise buyers. B is more product-y but okay for mid-market.
kevin: Add short badge line: "SLA-backed / Single-tenant / Enterprise support" under hero.
sara: Also include a quick toggle: Typical configs (4 GPUs / 16 GPUs / custom) — customers like quick sizing.
maya: PRIVATE HERO VARIANTS:
maya: i) "Run Redwood in your VPC or on-prem" — sub: "Full control, audit logs, and KMS integrations for regulated workloads."
maya: ii) "Private deployments for sensitive data and compliance" — sub: "Air-gapped install option, customer-managed keys, and on-prem support."
kevin: Use i) for marketing page, ii) for enterprise sales collateral.
jonas: Also need 1-line migration benefit: "Seamless API compatibility with Hosted" — removes lock-in concerns.
maya: Copy asks: 1) pick one hero per page, 2) confirm 2 CTAs (trial/contact-sales/docs), 3) approve micro-benefits list.
kevin: For Hosted CTAs: ["Start free", "Benchmarks"]. Dedicated CTAs: ["Contact sales", "Estimate capacity"]. Private CTAs: ["Contact sales", "Request security brief"].
sara: Micro-benefits (short bullets): Hosted — "Low latency", "Streaming & functions", "Transparent pricing". Dedicated — "Reserved GPU pools", "SLA-backed", "Autoscale + burst". Private — "VPC & KMS", "Air-gapped option", "Enterprise support".
maya: Great. Quick wording tweak — reduce "SLA-backed" to "SLA" (one word) and change "Transparent pricing" to "Cost breakdowns"
jonas: Approved. Also suggest adding a small trust row (logos for cloud partners) below dedicated hero.
kevin: Ops note: include a short sentence about model compatibility/quantization recommendations so infra teams see it's supported.
maya: I'll update drafts and post side-by-side A/B screenshots in #design for final sign-off by EOD tomorrow.
ops-bot: Reminder: deploy window for marketing site is scheduled for 2026-03-24 22:00 UTC.
maya: Thanks — tagging design + product for final pass. @sara @jonas @kevin : please thumbs up on the chosen hero lines in this thread when you see them. :thumbsup:
jonas: 👍
sara: 👍
kevin: 👍
maya: I'll push the copy to the CMS and link preview when done.
